title: EC names 11 nodal officers to run the 2027 Manipur Assembly polls
summary: IPS officer Kamei Angam Romanus will oversee the law and order and security plan.
image_credit: Photo: Election Commission of India / [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Polling_officials_carrying_the_Electronic_Voting_Machine_(EVMs)_and_other_necessary_inputs_required_for_the_Assam_Assembly_Election,_at_a_distribution_centre,_in_Tinsukia,_Assam_on_March_26,_2021.jpg), GODL-India
body:
The Election Commission has appointed 11 nodal officers for next year's Manipur Assembly election, according to a notification from the state's Chief Electoral Officer issued on the evening of October 27.

Senior IPS officer Kamei Angam Romanus is in charge of the law and order and security plan. IAS officer Hungyo Worshang will handle excise, Konsam Binku will monitor election spending, and Khumanthem Diana will manage transport. Other nodal officers cover computerisation, cyber security and the communication plan.

Polling is expected in February or March 2027. Senior EC officials visited Imphal last week to check preparations across all 16 districts.
